title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government is responding to a 2020 report on artificial intelligence and its impact on public standards. The response outlines the government's plan to address the report's recommendations on AI regulation and its effects on society.

title: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) in education
description: The Department for Education’s (DfE) position on the use of generative AI in the education sector.
summary: The Department for Education is addressing the use of generative AI in schools to clarify its position and ensure the technology is used responsibly and safely. This policy aims to guide educators and decision-makers on effective and ethical deployment of generative AI in educational settings.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: Ofqual's policy document explains how they plan to regulate the use of artificial intelligence in educational qualifications. It provides a framework for ensuring AI is used fairly and accurately in assessing students.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This document is a report and assessment of how copyright laws affect the use of copyrighted materials in the creation of artificial intelligence systems. It evaluates the impact of copyright on AI development, likely addressing issues like licensing and permissions.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The UK government is responding to the House of Lords Select Committee's report on artificial intelligence, which expressed concerns about the country's preparedness for the impact of AI. The government's response outlines its plans to address these concerns and promote responsible AI development in the UK.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This document outlines the terms of reference and frequently asked questions for a committee reviewing the intersection of artificial intelligence and public standards. It aims to establish guidelines for the committee's assessment of the impact of AI on societal standards.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The Cabinet Office's Security and Vulnerability Policy team (CSPL) provided comments to a committee examining how to control Artificial Intelligence. Their submission aimed to guide decision-making on AI governance.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This policy document explores how artificial intelligence affects the regulation of medical products. It aims to implement the principles outlined in the AI White Paper.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the defence organisation the most effective, efficient, trusted, and influential in the world for its size through the use of AI. This vision will likely involve implementing AI technologies across various defence operations and functions.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: The Transport artificial intelligence action plan aims to harness the benefits of AI in the transport sector while minimizing potential risks. It outlines how the Department for Transport will work with other organizations to achieve this goal.
